description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the ModuleDao in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing module retrieval and status update functionalities within the Admin DAO plugin.

classes.name: ModuleDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the ModuleDao's functionality related to modules' list retrieval and status updates in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating a ModuleDao instance and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetModuleList
methods.description: Tests that getModuleList returns the expected number of modules and verifies the first module's name and status.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatus
methods.description: Tests updating module statuses and verifies changes via fetching the module objects.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatusForReturnedValues
methods.description: Ensures that updateModuleStatus returns the correct number of module objects with updated statuses.

methods.name: testUpdateModuleStatusWithModulesDoesNotExists
methods.description: Tests updating module statuses with a module that does not exist to verify it does not affect other modules.

methods.name: testDisabledModuleList
methods.description: Verifies that getDisabledModuleList returns the correct list of disabled modules.
